items.definition:
human beings collectively
The future of humankind depends on our actions today.

An oven for baking pottery or bricks
The potter fired the clay pots in the kiln.

The focus of public attention
The young actress enjoyed being in the limelight.

A predatory insect, typically green or brown, with a triangular head and large forelegs
A praying mantis can turn its head almost 180 degrees.

A person authorized to perform certain legal formalities, especially to draw up or certify contracts, deeds, and other documents
You need to get this document signed by a notary public.

The part of a baseball field beyond the infield
The ball flew high into the outfield.

A small field or enclosure where horses are kept or exercised
The horses were grazing peacefully in the paddock.

a sudden strong feeling of pain or distress
She felt a sudden pang of guilt after lying.

a feather used as a pen
In ancient times, people wrote with a quill and ink.

the process of cleaning and decorating a room or building
The old hotel is undergoing a major refurbishment.

a discussion or conference involving several participants
Experts held a roundtable discussion on climate change.

a long deep track made by a wheel or a habit that has become boring
He felt stuck in a rut and needed a change.

a traditional Muslim greeting
He greeted them with a salaam and a warm smile.

a state of total disorder
After the party, the house was in a complete shambles.

the destruction of a ship at sea
Divers explored the ancient shipwreck at the bottom of the ocean.

a ski race down a winding course marked by poles
The skier expertly navigated the slalom course.

a low-melting alloy used for joining metal parts
He used solder to connect the wires on the circuit board.

a tapering structure on the roof of a church or temple
The church's tall spire reached towards the sky.

a strong and very unpleasant smell
The garbage left a terrible stench in the alley.

the action or fact of maintaining or supporting oneself at a minimum level
Many families in the region live at a subsistence level.

the operation or coordination of things to work together at the same time or rate
We need to ensure the synchronization of all the devices.

a thing that is placed on top of something else
She wore a stylish topper to the event.

the quality or state of being unwilling
Her unwillingness to compromise caused the delay.

a device that vibrates
The phone's vibrator alerted him to the incoming call.

the profession or duties of an accountant
She decided to pursue a career in accountancy.

a claim or piece of evidence that one was elsewhere when an act, typically a criminal one, is alleged to have taken place
The suspect had a strong alibi for the night of the robbery.

a small wheel on a swivel, set into the leg or base of a piece of furniture or other object to enable it to be moved easily
The office chair needs a new caster because one is broken.

an item or collection of items in the center of a table, typically for decoration; the most important or attractive item
The large floral arrangement was the centerpiece of the dining table.

a small, slow-moving lizard with a prehensile tail, long extensible tongue, and eyes that can be moved independently
The chameleon changed its color to blend in with the leaves.

a fastener or a tight hold
She fastened the necklace with a delicate clasp.

a strong, irresistible urge
He felt a strong compulsion to check the door again.

skill in a particular craft
The antique clock showed remarkable craftsmanship.

a tiny drop of a liquid
A tiny droplet of water ran down the windowpane.

a person who seeks to convert others to the Christian faith, especially by public preaching
The evangelist traveled to many cities to spread his message.

a brief, wavering light or movement
A flicker of hope appeared in her eyes.

a small ornament or piece of material attached to a watch chain or key ring; to deceive or put off with a trick
He attached his keys to a new key fob.

a framework of bars or wires, typically one that is set into a door or window or that acts as a screen or barrier
The car's front grille was damaged in the accident.

the floor of a fireplace; the area in front of a fireplace
We gathered around the hearth to warm ourselves by the fire.

a forecast of a person's future, typically including a delineation of character and circumstances, based on the relative positions of the stars and planets at the time of that person's birth
She reads her horoscope every morning to see what the day holds.

the practice of forming or pursuing ideals, especially unrealistically
His youthful idealism often clashed with the harsh realities of politics.

the action of improvising; something that is improvised
The jazz band's performance was full of brilliant improvisation.

a special uniform or distinctive design
The airline's new livery featured bold colors.

mechanical; mechanic
The mech department handles all repairs.

a bad or unsuitable match
There was a clear mismatch between their skills and the job requirements.

Multi-Level Marketing
MLM companies often rely on direct sales.

a person or thing having the same name as another
He was named after his grandfather, his namesake.

the quality of being objective
It's hard to maintain objectivity in such a situation.

a monstrous giant
The ogre lived in a swamp.

a simple story used to illustrate a moral or spiritual lesson
The teacher told a parable about kindness.

material made by sewing together small pieces of different fabrics
She made a beautiful patchwork quilt.

an extreme or irrational fear of or aversion to something
She has a phobia of spiders.

A game played on a machine with flippers.
We spent hours playing pinball at the arcade.

Stolen goods; loot.
The pirates divided their plunder among themselves.

The quality of being based on or in accordance with reason or logic.
Her decision was based on pure rationality, not emotion.

A person or thing that brings relief.
The new medication proved to be a great pain reliever.

A temporary structure used to support workers and materials during construction.
The workers erected scaffolding around the building for repairs.

An Arab leader, in particular the chief or head of an Arab tribe, family, or village.
The sheik welcomed the visitors to his desert tent.

A slow-moving tree-dwelling mammal, or laziness.
The sloth moved incredibly slowly through the trees.

A reduction in speed or activity.
There has been a noticeable slowdown in the economy.

A person who smuggles goods illegally.
Customs officers caught the smuggler trying to bring in illegal goods.

informer, telltale
The student was called a snitch for telling the teacher about the cheating.

the longest/shortest day of the year
The summer solstice marks the longest day of the year.

a rod or pin
The thread wound around the spindle of the spinning wheel.

a parody, a hoax
The movie was a clever spoof of classic horror films.
